question: Who among the following was the founder of the Arya Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dayanand Saraswati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dayanand Saraswati** was an Indian philosopher, social leader, and founder of the Arya Samaj, a reform movement of the Vedic dharma.
 
• He was born on February 12, 1824, in Tankara, Gujarat, and his original name was Mool Shankar Tiwari.
 
• Dayanand Saraswati promoted the values of the Vedas and advocated for social reforms such as the abolition of the caste system and child marriage.
 
• His motto was "Back to the Vedas," emphasizing the importance of returning to the teachings of the Vedas to reform society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arya Samaj:**

 
 
• The Arya Samaj is a Hindu reform movement that promotes values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
• It was established on April 7, 1875, in Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• The Arya Samaj has been instrumental in promoting education, social reform, and the removal of superstitions and caste discrimination in India.
 
 
 
• **Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar:**
 
 
• He was a prominent Indian educator and social reformer of the 19th century.
 
• He is best known for his efforts to promote education, especially for women, and for his role in the widow remarriage movement.
 
 
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak:**
 
 
• Tilak was an Indian nationalist, teacher, and an independence activist.
 
• He was one of the first leaders of the Indian Independence Movement and is often referred to as "Lokmanya" Tilak.
 
 
 
• **Ram Mohan Roy:**
 
 
• He was a prominent Indian social reformer and the founder of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He is known for his efforts to abolish practices such as Sati and child marriage and for promoting modern education in India.
